skills.name: parse_command_values
skills.description: Read-only English number/date/duration values with original offsets. Pass the user's verbatim words. Use before scheduling; report the resolved timestamp and explicit timezone (default Asia/Kolkata). If requires_clarification, ask before acting. candidate_only means nothing was scheduled. Bare times need AM/PM; quotes, paths and IDs are data. Temporal parsing needs optional dependencies; errors are not no-match results.

text.description: Original user words, at most 512 characters.

anchor_datetime.description: Optional ISO reference time with explicit UTC offset; omitted means current time in time_zone.

time_zone.description: Explicit IANA timezone. Do not guess ambiguous abbreviations.
